title: Guard Models Are Overconfident Where Base Models Are Uncertain
abstract: arXiv:2609.36477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Guard models are used as safety classifiers, with confidence scores driving downstream moderation decisions. We evaluate five guard models for prompt classification and find that although several are nearly calibrated on clean inputs, adversarial attacks degrade their calibration by an order of magnitude, turning false negatives into high-confidence errors indistinguishable from correct detections. Comparing each guard with its corresponding base LM, we find that uncertainty signals often remain available, with the base model typically expressing uncertainty on the same inputs where the guard fails. Layer-wise analyses localize this guard-base divergence to later layers, where guard models exhibit sharper safe/unsafe separation and lower-rank representations, while adversarial harmful inputs lie closer to the clean-safe region. These findings highlight a mismatch between guard confidence and base model uncertainty under attack.

translated_title: 防护模型在基础模型不确定之处反而过度自信
translated_abstract: 防护模型被用作安全分类器，其置信度分数驱动下游的内容审核决策。我们评估了五个用于提示分类的防护模型，发现尽管其中几个在干净输入上几乎校准良好，但对抗攻击会使它们的校准性能下降一个数量级，将假阴性转化为与正确检测无法区分的高置信度错误。通过将每个防护模型与其对应的基础语言模型进行比较，我们发现不确定性信号通常仍然可用，基础模型往往在防护模型失败的相同输入上表现出不确定性。逐层分析将这种防护模型与基础模型之间的分歧定位在较后的层，在这些层中，防护模型表现出更尖锐的安全/不安全分离和更低秩的表示，而对抗性有害输入则更接近干净安全区域。这些发现凸显了在攻击下防护模型置信度与基础模型不确定性之间的不匹配。
tldr: 研究发现对抗攻击会使安全防护模型的校准性能下降一个数量级，将假阴性转化为高置信度错误，而对应的基础语言模型在同一输入上通常仍能表达不确定性，揭示了攻击下防护模型置信度与基础模型不确定性之间的不匹配。
en_tdlr: Adversarial attacks degrade the calibration of guard models by an order of magnitude, turning false negatives into high-confidence errors, while the corresponding base LMs typically still express uncertainty on the same inputs, revealing a mismatch between guard confidence and base model uncertainty under attack.
